list: the official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18 (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is not a task of its own: it lands the moment the other 54 trophies are on your profile. Guides put the list at roughly 200 hours with no difficulty setting, no online requirement and one playthrough, since free roam continues after the credits. Watch the remaining count at the top of this tracker rather than chasing the platinum directly.
trophies.tips: Check the silver and gold rows first: 100% completion, 250 stunts and the shooting-range golds are what actually decide how long the platinum takes.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Pops at the end of Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, so a fresh save earns it inside the first hour. Nothing in the mission can be failed in a way that costs the trophy. PowerPyx files it as an automatic story trophy with no other condition.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 1; both PowerPyx and GTABase place the pop at the start of Chapter 2, when What's in the Bag? opens, not on the last mission of Chapter 1 itself. Nothing in the chapter can lock it out. The one thing to do first is Lucia's balcony meditation, which is only offered before this point.
trophies.tips: Make a manual save at the end of Chapter 1: this is the last moment the balcony meditation can be taken.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. GTABase puts the unlock at the start of Chapter 3, after Welcome to Vice City. Chapter 2 is also where partner free roam (Coffee Break), the Scooter Bros app and the garage property market open, so several other trophies become possible as this one lands.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. PowerPyx and GTABase both place the pop after the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is where the Snap Gun and jewelry jobs (Yasmani), the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering and the Key Cloner strand begin.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. PowerPyx ties the pop to the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero. It cannot be missed and needs no performance in the mission. Save before that last stretch if you still want to leave optional content for later.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission; it is the second of the list's two golds. GTABase notes free roam carries on after the credits, so every 100% task can be cleaned up afterwards. There is no mission replay and no trophy depends on how a mission is played.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unlocks during Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 main mission (PowerPyx titles it as checking on Jason). Automatic once the mission ends, with no optional objective attached.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unlocks during The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission. Automatic, no extra requirement. It sits in the same chapter as the jewelry and laundering unlocks, so a story run picks it up without a detour.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unlocks during Child's Play, the Chapter 4 main mission in which Rafa is rescued from kidnappers. Automatic, with nothing to fail beyond the mission itself, which restarts from a checkpoint if you do.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unlocks during Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission built around a launch party. Automatic, and it arrives in the same chapter as the other three Chapter 4 story trophies.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unlocks during VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission. Automatic. It has nothing to do with the airport plane trophy Catch Me If You Can beyond sharing the airport as a location.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unlocks during Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission. Automatic, and one of the last story trophies before the final-mission gold, so it marks the end of the story stretch of the roadmap.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game list under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, which appears once the story is done; progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on it can be missed. It is not true 100%: required in full are all robberies (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), the underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks, while only a share of the rest counts: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans.
trophies.tips: Do the required-in-full categories first; they are also the ones that carry their own trophies. Use the in-game checklist, not this tracker, as the authority for the last few percent.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge fly-unders, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges in a helicopter or plane is the fastest way to add numbers, and the optional challenge attached to each stunt is not needed. The 100% checklist wants 300, so this trophy arrives on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.tips: Track the count under Progress > Activities > Stunts and turn the stunt spots on in the map filter.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, an arcade game, winning a race and a stunt. Progress > Activities lists each type with its count, and the map's Activities filter shows what is nearby. Most types are introduced by the story, so this usually fills itself.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds spread over 12 ranges. Golds reward accuracy and speed, so learn a range's target order on a first run and retry for time. Range practice also raises Focus, which helps with Gunslinger.
trophies.tips: Nine of the 42 are usually the last: keep the range's own score screen open and restart instead of leaving the building.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so clear every race at a location in one visit. Locations appear as the map unfogs.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on the map; winning the same race twice does not count towards the twenty. Combine it with Top Fun by taking a drone race at each location, and pick short routes over long ones.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After meeting Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts a purple fishing marker; play his fishing strand and beat him in the challenge. Fishing is a timing minigame, so wait for the bite before reeling. GTABase notes the strand stays open after the story, so a lost challenge costs nothing.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade cabinets: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are on the TV at Jason and Lucia's home and playable from Chapter 1; the fourth is on cabinets out in Leonida. Finishing means reaching the end of the game, not setting a score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's five jobs are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when she gets his call and the Belville address. The order is Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass, and the last one awards the trophy. All five stay on the map in free roam, so the strand cannot be closed off.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton, the green KR marker in Key Lento, hires Jason in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from seven shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers and dig with the metal detector. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and texts again later, so the strand is finished after the story. Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures tracks the seven.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs are marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County once Coffee Break in Chapter 2 is done, and the fifth, Hometown Heroes, is the one that awards the trophy. The strand stays available after the credits, so it needs no special timing.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands anywhere in Leonida. GTABase counts Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete as qualifying and the Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie lines as not counting, so pick strangers rather than contacts. The trophy's own counter in the trophy list is the reliable check on progress. None of it is needed for 100%, and the strands stay open after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also gives you the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City, and scan cars with WAiNK to see whether they are on it; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best hunting grounds. Better condition pays more but is not required.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: A Jason-only strand: after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone marks synthetic labs around Vice City in purple. Destroy the labs, and his last job, Shut Down the Labs, awards the trophy. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida; meditating at a spot with both characters together counts twice, and the last spot needs both, which becomes possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The one that can be lost: the morning after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony at home and accept her meditation, because the scene disappears once Chapter 1 ends and guides still disagree on whether the trophy counts it. Track the total under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
trophies.tips: A manual save before the last Chapter 1 mission turns a lost balcony meditation into a five-minute rewind instead of a second 200-hour run.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel texts Jason after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (Lucia cannot receive it) and starts Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Hunt the animals on his purple Target Decks with a rifle; a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not settled, and all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them. Progress > Collections shows each set's count and the cards still missing, and the cards sit in fixed spots, so a set is a short tour once the remainder is known.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app: hold Up on the D-pad, then R1/RB. The pool is 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags, so any hundred count. A hundred WAiNK scans are also part of the 100% checklist, so the trophy comes first.
trophies.tips: Scanning from a car covers ground quickly, and the app marks what is already scanned.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges; Progress > Challenges ticks the finished ones. Many complete themselves as you play, and the 100% checklist wants 70, so this arrives on the way. Ten challenges are spare, which means the slowest ones can be left alone.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once both characters can be out together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner with Right on the D-pad then Triangle/Y, build a four-star wanted level and escape. It only counts after you are out of the red heat zone, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a known place to lose helicopters. Bank vault robberies always give four stars, so the trophy often pops there by accident.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner along, rob three shops back-to-back while the police are still chasing you; losing the wanted level breaks the chain. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3, are close enough to chain, and body armour and healing items make the run survivable. The trophy can lag about thirty seconds after the third shop, so rob a fourth before deciding it failed.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK; you never have to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic, or sweep a car park. The 100% checklist wants 200 base models, so this comes well before A Long Road.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies inside one Combat Focus, triggered by clicking both sticks while aiming a firearm. Fill the Focus meter first, since eating, drinking and washing up at home raise it and Adrenaline extends the window, then use an accurate automatic rifle such as the Duke 556. Gang-operation thugs count; police, soldiers and civilians appear not to.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA (planes parked out on the airfield do not count), back it out, take off and fly about a kilometre clear of the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easy ones: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs. It is a hidden trophy, so expect no hint in the list until it pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, where the tanks stand at the south end of the base. Drive in through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, then take enemies out from inside the tank until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 unlock jewelry-store robberies and the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors. Use the Snap Gun on the back door rather than kicking it in, find the safe-code note in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted, since setting off the alarm voids the attempt. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the store most guides use.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is...: tail a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it stands open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner, and since vaults always give four stars, escape on a fast bike and switch vehicles. Five of the eight vaults are enough for the trophy and all eight are needed for 100%.
trophies.tips: Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 if a particular vault is hard to find.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck as long as you then escape the heat or reach a Pay 'n' Spray, so this often arrives together with Maximum Withdrawal. Earlier in the game, box in a moving armored truck, sticky-bomb its back doors, blow them and get away.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. Flying a plane over every dark patch is the quickest method and you never need to land; the trophy tracks map discovery, not collectibles, so a handful of long flights finishes it.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs; they are the yellow map icons, many of them marked by story progress. Progress > Gangs keeps the count, and repeating a gang does not help. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this one comes on the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail somewhere with a view over Ocean Beach in Vice City. PowerPyx names the Ocean View rooftop bar and an Apple Martini, drunk while standing next to the bar. It is a hidden trophy, so nothing in the list hints at the bar until it pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it out through the showroom window. PowerPyx notes the car can only be taken once you have the Key Cloner from Randy's Chapter 3 strand, so finish that first. Hidden trophy, no in-game hint.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take all three valuables — the watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table and the safe in the north-east hallway, which needs sticky bombs — then lose the police. The robbery takes a long time to come back, so take everything in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength on both Jason and Lucia, visible under Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu. Work out at fitness clubs from the map's Activities filter with your partner along, because training one trains the other, and after the story you can also train at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile; the trophy itself shows the count out of 500 when you open it. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings > UI so each shift is visible, and otherwise play normally, since robberies and fights add up quickly. Do not push the meter all the way to Irredeemable, which is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description, Second time's the charm, points to succeeding at something on a second attempt, and PowerPyx links it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but no guide has confirmed the trigger. Treat it as a clean-up trophy: play a full run and check the tracker afterwards before hunting it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This is the UFO Easter egg: on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2 AM and alone. A blinking car at the roadside means the event can fire; if it is not there, drive away and come back, because the spawn is not guaranteed. Follow the prompt that appears beside the car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description asks for a melee drive-by: knock somebody down from a moving vehicle with a melee attack. PowerPyx suspects kicking enemies from a motorcycle, and no guide has confirmed the trigger yet. Try it against gang members rather than pedestrians and check the trophy list after each attempt.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to get the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and sell the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is a running total across robberies, not one delivery. Bank vaults hand over up to $205,000 a time but only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is...

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a running total of $100,000 across shops of any kind. Guns, car mods and tattoos use money fastest, with 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and the clothing and electronics stores on the map. Robberies fund it, so do it after a few scores rather than grinding a job.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages for sale through the Vice City Real Estate app, which installs after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; the four garages the story hands you do not count. The eight cost about $160,000 together. Robberies are the quickest way to raise it, and the garages also give On the Spot its parking space.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives with Moses' Chapter 2 mission, and stolen vehicles are registered at his Port Gellhorn garage after a respray. At first he takes only cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray can register tracked ones. Each registration costs money and needs free garage space, so use cheap cars and bikes.

notes: Hidden flags follow the 28 trophies PSN hides until earned (PlanetGTA6). Guides are written for this entry; each cites where its facts come from.
